title: Lovable vs Bolt
summary: Lovable vs Bolt: founders comparing a web prototype and its eventual code handoff.

sections.heading: Make the prototype comparable
paragraphs: Specify one form, one authenticated path and one persisted record. Check validation, access control and error states manually before comparing appearance. Do not treat a generated login screen as proof of secure authorization.

sections.heading: Test an exit before committing
paragraphs: Review the code handoff, database export and independent deployment path. Track build credits or tokens separately from live-app costs. These are different billing units and cannot be converted with a universal exchange rate.

sections.heading: When neither is a fit
paragraphs: If your required security, data location or operating environment is not supported by current evidence, pause the purchase. Use the sources below to resolve the missing constraint before accepting a recommendation.

verdict: Compare the handoff and operating requirements of your prototype, not the number of prompts in a demo.
bestFor: Founders comparing a web prototype and its eventual code handoff
notFor: Teams treating a working demo as a security or production-readiness test
migration: Trial the candidate on a branch; retain the original workflow until tests, export and billing checks pass.
